title: Dolaylı soru ve emir: Nerede yaşadığımı sordu + ilişkiler

sections.heading: Dolaylı soru: soru sırası bozulur
sections.body:
Soru aktarılırken asked kullanılır ve cümle düz cümle sırasına döner (do / did kalkar):

SöylenenAktarılan
“Where do you live?”She asked me where I lived.
“What time is it?”He asked what time it was.
“Are you OK?” (evet / hayır)He asked if I was OK.
“Do you like it?”She asked if I liked it.

✘ She asked me where did I live. → ✔ She asked me where I lived.
Evet / hayır sorularında if (veya whether «[{w}e]-{d}ı») eklenir.

sections.heading: Kibar soru: Do you know where…?
sections.body:
Aynı kural kibar sorularda da geçerlidir. İngilizler doğrudan soru yerine sık kullanır:

Where is the station? → Do you know where the station is?
What time does it open? → Could you tell me what time it opens?

sections.heading: Dolaylı emir ve rica: to / not to
sections.body:
“Wait here.” → He told me to wait there.
“Don't be late.” → She told us not to be late.
“Can you help me?” → He asked me to help him.
